findings.title: Referee decline links cannot complete the browser flow.
findings.scenario: Omar asks Tom to provide a reference. Tom clicks the decline link in the email, but its signed-token address does not match the browser page. The browser operation also calls an obsolete address, so Tom cannot record his refusal.
findings.test_needed: Follow Omar's actual emailed decline link as Tom and verify it records rejection through the signed-token endpoint.

owner_question.question: When Tom clicks the decline link for Omar's reference request, what should happen?
options: Record Tom's refusal and show confirmation
Ask Tom to confirm before recording refusal
Leave Tom unable to decline through the link (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Renaming a group on mobile silently removes its other members.
findings.scenario: Tom renames a custom group containing Omar and Mia using the mobile app. Saving the name also removes Omar and Mia from the group because the omitted member selection becomes an empty replacement list. Tom remains as creator, while Omar and Mia lose access.
findings.test_needed: Rename Tom's group without supplying participants and verify Omar and Mia remain participants.

owner_question.question: When Tom changes only a group's name, what should happen to Omar and Mia?
options: Keep Omar and Mia in the group
Require Tom to confirm any membership changes
Remove everyone except Tom (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Mobile group member search cannot find returned participants.
findings.scenario: Tom opens mobile group creation and searches for Omar, who is available in his chat contacts. Omar's name is returned inside his identity details, but the search checks a different location and shows no match. Tom cannot select Omar to create the group or add him to an existing group.
findings.test_needed: Return Omar with a nested user identity, search his name in mobile group creation, and verify he is selectable.

owner_question.question: When Tom searches for Omar among available mobile group contacts, what should happen?
options: Find Omar by his displayed name
Show all available contacts for Tom to select
Return no matches for nested contact names (keep today's behaviour)
